canonical_skill.note: The Skill keeps host handoff weak and now distinguishes API-only capability discovery from the explicit npm-backed update check.

server_contract.note: The distribution contract advances for the clarified host discovery boundary while server-side Mission planning remains the Work Model owner.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.33 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.8.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.28 keeps capabilities on Corvio API authority and contacts npm only for the explicit update check.

help_center.note: User-facing guidance distinguishes API capability discovery from registry-backed package freshness.

package_setup.note: OAuth, MCP endpoint and package installation steps are unchanged.

harness_and_mainline.note: Direct Missions align source-child identity/access, lifecycle-backed materialization authority, unpinned topology, and composite CLI receipt evidence before unchanged longitudinal replay.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and full independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover AgentRun child identity, direct-Mission Prompt contracts, API-only capabilities, explicit registry checks, and Host receipt preservation.
